bias.zh: 中性 · 失守 $160，测试 30 日均线

read.en: SpaceX fell 4.2% on Oct 13 to $156.54; with 85 sessions of history it has no 100 or 200-day averages yet. It dropped below its 5-day ($162.1) and 10-day ($161.2) averages and holds above the 30-day ($153.0). MACD is still above its signal (since Oct 5) but the histogram has faded to almost zero, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 2 ($154.6), and RSI is 52.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月13日下跌 4.2%，收于 $156.54；上市仅 85 个交易日，尚无 100 日和 200 日均线。股价跌破 5 日（$162.1）和 10 日均线（$161.2），守在 30 日均线（$153.0）上方。MACD 仍位于信号线上方（自 10月5日起），但柱状图已收窄至接近零，抛物线 SAR 自 10月2日起看多（$154.6），RSI 为 52。

read.en: The close broke the $160 support (Oct 8–9 lows and 10-day average), which becomes first resistance. Above it are $167.5 (Oct 7 and 12 highs) and $176 (Jun 30 and Oct 6 highs). Support is $153–154.6 (30-day average and SAR), then $145 (Sep 28 low). A close below $154.6 would flip the SAR bearish; below $153 opens $145.
read.zh: 收盘跌破 $160 支撑（10月8–9日低点及 10 日均线），该位置转为第一阻力。其上为 $167.5（10月7日及 12日高点）和 $176（6月30日及 10月6日高点）。支撑为 $153–154.6（30 日均线及 SAR），其次 $145（9月28日低点）。若收盘跌破 $154.6，SAR 将转为看空；跌破 $153 则打开至 $145 的空间。
